meanings.en: to put, to place, to lay down

meanings.en: to check, to test, to verify
meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'верить'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to check, to test', paired with 'проверять'.

examples.text: Вот с таким настроением и иди к Аникееву. Паяльник проверь.
examples.trans: Go to Anikeev in just that mood. Check the soldering iron.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'check, inspection, test' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'product, foodstuff' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (root 'падать'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to immediately'.
